special_queries.description: List all trips scheduled or created today for the company.
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context is required to list today's trips.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, l.name AS location, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN location l ON t.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND t.scheduled_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: List all currently active (en-route or in-progress) trips with vehicle info.
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context required to list active trips.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, l.name AS location, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date, t.vehicle_dispatch_date_time AS dispatch_time FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN location l ON t.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND t.is_active = 1 AND (tsm.id IS NULL OR tsm.id NOT IN (21)) ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: List trips associated with vehicles — shows vehicle numbers alongside trip details.
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context required to list vehicle trips.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, l.name AS location, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN location l ON t.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND t.is_active = 1 ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Show current status of all trips — what each trip is doing right now.
example_queries: what is the status of trips
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context required to show trip statuses.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, tsm.display_type AS current_status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND t.is_active = 1 ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Show the full status timeline/log for trips.
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context required to show trip history.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, tsm.display_type AS status, tl.date_created AS event_time, tl.comments FROM trip_log tl JOIN trip t ON tl.trip_id = t.id JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE t.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} ORDER BY tl.orderby_date DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: List cancelled trips.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND tsm.id = 21 ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: List completed trips.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date, t.vehicle_dispatch_date_time FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND tsm.id IN (12, 15) ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Count trips by status — summary of how many trips are in each state.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(tsm.display_type, 'Unknown') AS status, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM trip t LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} GROUP BY tsm.display_type ORDER BY trip_count DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Find the vehicle with the highest total overspeed count by aggregating vts_exception records.
example_queries: which truck reported as many times overspeeded
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context is required to rank overspeed vehicles.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0)) AS total_overspeed_events, COUNT(*) AS exception_records FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND (ve.is_over_speed = 1 OR COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0) > 0) AND TRIM(COALESCE(v.vehicle_number, '')) <> '' GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY total_overspeed_events DESC, exception_records DESC, v.vehicle_number ASC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: List all active vehicles registered to the company.
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context required to list vehicles.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, v.make, v.model, v.capacity, v.contractor_name, CASE WHEN v.is_vts_enabled = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS vts_enabled FROM vehicle v WHERE v.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} ORDER BY v.vehicle_number ASC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: List vehicles with route deviation exceptions.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.route_deviation_count, 0)) AS deviation_count FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND COALESCE(ve.route_deviation_count, 0) > 0 GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY deviation_count DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Rank locations by number of trips.
example_queries: which location has the most trips
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT l.name AS location_name, l.location_code, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM trip t LEFT JOIN location l ON t.location_id = l.id WHERE t.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND t.location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.location_id, l.name, l.location_code ORDER BY trip_count DESC, location_name ASC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: List all active locations/terminals/depots.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT l.name, l.location_code, l.address, CASE WHEN l.is_vts_enabled = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS vts_enabled FROM location l WHERE l.is_active = 1 ORDER BY l.name ASC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: List all active routes with source and destination location names.
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context required to list routes.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT r.route_code, sl.name AS source_location, dl.name AS destination_location, ROUND(r.distance_in_meters / 1000, 1) AS distance_km FROM route r LEFT JOIN location sl ON r.source_location_id = sl.id LEFT JOIN location dl ON r.destination_location_id = dl.id WHERE r.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND r.is_active = 1 ORDER BY r.route_code ASC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Show when each vehicle was overspeeding — date, vehicle number, count and duration.
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context required to show overspeed history.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, ve.date_created AS date, ve.over_speed_count AS overspeed_count, ROUND(ve.over_speed_duration / 60, 1) AS overspeed_duration_min FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND (ve.is_over_speed = 1 OR COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0) > 0) ORDER BY ve.date_created DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Full exception breakdown per vehicle: overspeed, halt, night driving, route deviation, harsh events.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0)) AS overspeed, SUM(COALESCE(ve.halt_count, 0)) AS halts, SUM(COALESCE(ve.night_driving_count, 0)) AS night_driving, SUM(COALESCE(ve.route_deviation_count, 0)) AS route_deviations, SUM(COALESCE(ve.harsh_braking_count, 0)) AS harsh_braking, SUM(COALESCE(ve.harsh_acceleration_count, 0)) AS harsh_acceleration FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY overspeed DESC, halts DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Show vehicles with halt events — which vehicles stopped and how many times.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.halt_count, 0)) AS halt_count, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ve.halt_duration, 0)) / 60, 1) AS halt_duration_min, MAX(ve.date_created) AS last_halt_date FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND (ve.is_halt = 1 OR COALESCE(ve.halt_count, 0) > 0) GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY halt_count DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Show vehicles with night driving violations.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.night_driving_count, 0)) AS night_driving_count, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ve.night_driving_duration, 0)) / 60, 1) AS night_driving_duration_min, MAX(ve.date_created) AS last_event_date FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND (ve.is_night_driving = 1 OR COALESCE(ve.night_driving_count, 0) > 0) GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY night_driving_count DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Show vehicles with harsh braking or harsh acceleration events.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.harsh_braking_count, 0)) AS harsh_braking, SUM(COALESCE(ve.harsh_acceleration_count, 0)) AS harsh_acceleration, SUM(COALESCE(ve.harsh_manoeuvring_count, 0)) AS harsh_manoeuvring, MAX(ve.date_created) AS last_event_date FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND (ve.is_harsh_braking = 1 OR ve.is_harsh_acceleration = 1 OR COALESCE(ve.harsh_braking_count, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(ve.harsh_acceleration_count, 0) > 0) GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY harsh_braking DESC, harsh_acceleration DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Show all exception events that occurred today.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, ve.date_created AS date, ve.over_speed_count AS overspeed, ve.halt_count AS halts, ve.route_deviation_count AS route_deviations, ve.harsh_braking_count AS harsh_braking, ve.night_driving_count AS night_driving FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND DATE(ve.date_created) = CURDATE() ORDER BY ve.date_created DESC LIMIT {limit};

special_queries.description: Show all exception events that occurred yesterday.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number, ve.date_created AS date, ve.over_speed_count AS overspeed, ve.halt_count AS halts, ve.route_deviation_count AS route_deviations, ve.harsh_braking_count AS harsh_braking, ve.night_driving_count AS night_driving FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND DATE(ve.date_created) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY ve.date_created DESC LIMIT {limit};
